abstract.t: This document examines the problem space for network resilience, focusing on the ability of networks to maintain acceptable service levels and recover from disruptive conditions. It identifies limitations of existing protection and recovery mechanisms under correlated, cascading, or evolving failures, and when resources or systems required for recovery are themselves impaired. It analyzes resilience challenges across risk anticipation, disruption absorption and adaptation, service recovery, and continuous improvement, and identifies corresponding capability gaps to be addressed.
